title: "Practical Statistics in R for Neuroscience"
subtitle: "SISSA PhD Course"
---

Welcome to the practical laboratory component of the Statistics course.

### Course Schedule Lecture1
- **Step 1**: Exploratory Data Analysis, Outlier Detection, Covariance & PCA
- **Step 2**: Continuous Distributions, the CLT, and Confidence Intervals
- **Step 3**: Hypothesis Testing, Power Analysis, and $t$-Tests
- **Step 4**: Correlation, Linear Regression & Multiple Comparisons
- **Step 5**: Mixed Effects Models & "Bring Your Own Data" Capstone

### Setup Instructions
Download the repository files to your computer, open `sissa-neuro-stats.Rproj`, and begin with Day 1 under the **Days** menu above.
